title: Instructor guide + train-the-trainer kit
context: For the curriculum to scale beyond its authors, instructors who were not involved in its creation must be able to set up and teach it independently. A train-the-trainer kit addresses the risk of the material being unadoptable without the original authors — a common failure mode for open educational resources. The kit enables external adopter (adopt-020) and drives the M3 success metric of >= 1 confirmed external adoption. Depends on: cohort-017 (must be taught at least once before a train-the-trainer kit can be grounded in real experience).
objective: Author an instructor guide and reusable train-the-trainer kit that enables a new instructor to set up, prepare, and deliver the curriculum without the original authors, covering all modules, accessibility requirements, timing, and common misconceptions; reviewed by Educator and Steward reviewers.
acceptanceCriteria: Instructor guide covers: setup (software, containers, repository checkout), timing per module (estimated minutes per section), common misconceptions and how to address them, and accessibility guidance per module.

Train-the-trainer package is reusable and self-contained: includes slide templates or presenter notes, instructor checklists for each module, and a guide for using the pre/post assessment (assessment-011).
Package enables a new instructor to teach the curriculum without contacting the original authors; all prerequisites (tools, accounts, data access) are documented.
Reviewed and signed off by Educator reviewer and Steward reviewer.
Committed to the project repo with DCO sign-off; CC-BY-4.0 license stated; accessible format.
resources: cohort-017 (first taught cohort — empirical basis for timing/misconceptions)
All published modules (pilot-006, versioning-008, provenance-009, analysis-010, sharing-014)
output: INSTRUCTOR-GUIDE.md and TRAIN-THE-TRAINER.md committed to the project repo; CC-BY-4.0; Educator and Steward reviewer sign-offs.
